title: ProjectIntent
description: STATE-03 projectIntent contract. The user-authored intent state that keeps the assistant from ruining the song. Source: docs/seed.md §C 'Intent state' + CONTEXT.md D-09.
$comment: Phase 2 freezes the intent shape (summary/constraints/targets). D-09: M1 is read-only + user-authored — the daemon does an atomic validated read of ~/.bw-brain/intent.json; NO inference (no defaults, no LLM-generated intent). summary is REQUIRED + minLength 1 (a blank intent file is structurally invalid). additionalProperties:false throughout (trust-spine — the schema is the gate). Editing UX (a future /intent command vs hand-edit) is the agent's discretion; M1 only needs to read it correctly. Phase 3 (D-12/D-14) extends projectIntent.properties additively with OPTIONAL harmonicCenter + profile fields — existing intent.json without these still validates (backward-compat).

projectIntent.description: The user's authored intent for this project. summary is the only required field — a one-line statement of what the project is / should be.

summary.description: MANDATORY non-empty one-line summary, e.g. 'techno track, dark, 130 BPM'. Cannot be blank.

constraints.description: Hard constraints the assistant must not violate, e.g. 'preserve bass motif'.

targets.description: Goals the assistant should aim for, e.g. 'build tension toward the drop'.

harmonicCenter.description: D-12 authored-default harmonic center. When present, transforms use this key/mode directly (no inference). When absent, a transform MAY run one-shot inference with an assumptions[] disclosure + refuse-below-bar (INV-12).

profile.description: D-14 genre profile opt-in. Absent → generic core runs literally (ARCH-02). 'techno' opts into the electronic/techno profile shipped inside the daemon package.
